meta.title: Fila
meta.description: One queue for the podcasts you follow, in the order they were released.

landing.title: The whole week, in one queue.
landing.subtitle: It gathers new episodes from the shows you follow, in release order, and plays them here.
landing.title3: Three stories that fit in your headphones
landing.point1Body: What came out this week shows up together, without hopping between shows.
landing.point2Body: Play, pause, jump back 15 seconds, and change the speed, right here.
landing.point3Title: The feed belongs to the show
landing.point3Body: Search finds the RSS feed through the public iTunes API. Episodes come from the show itself.

auth.name: What should we call you
auth.forgotLead: Enter the account email. If it exists, we send a link to choose a new password.
auth.forgotSentEmail: If that email has an account, the link is on its way. It lasts 30 minutes.
auth.forgotSentLog: With no mail server, the link is written to the API log (logs/api.log) when the account exists. It lasts 30 minutes.
auth.resetLead: Choose a new password for this account.
auth.resetDone: You can log in with the new password.

fields.displayName: Use a name between 2 and 40 characters.
fields.password: Password must be between 8 and 72 characters.
fields.feedUrl: Paste an http or https feed address.
fields.nextPassword: The new password needs at least 8 characters.
fields.confirm: The two passwords need to match.

errors.EMAIL_TAKEN: That email already has an account.
errors.VALIDATION: Check the fields and try again.
errors.ALREADY_FOLLOWING: This show is already in your queue.
errors.FEED_UNREADABLE: I couldn't read that podcast feed.
errors.FEED_URL_BLOCKED: That feed URL can't be used.
errors.DIRECTORY_UNAVAILABLE: Podcast search is unavailable right now.
errors.EPISODE_NOT_FOUND: I couldn't find that episode in your queue.
errors.RESET_TOKEN_INVALID: That link expired or was already used. Ask for another.

queue.count: {count, plural, =0 {Nothing new here} one {# episode in the queue} other {# episodes in the queue}}
queue.emptyBody: Follow a podcast and new episodes land here, newest release first.
queue.refreshFailed: Couldn't refresh {failed, plural, one {# feed} other {# feeds}}.

search.title: Search
search.prompt: Search for a show or paste its RSS feed.
search.empty: Nothing under that name. Try the feed link.
search.rssHelp: The address that ends in .xml, or the feed the show publishes.

library.title: Library
library.empty: You haven't followed a podcast yet.

settings.title: Settings
settings.about: Search uses the public iTunes API only to find the feed. Episodes come from each podcast's RSS.
